High above the cloudline on the floating: In alto, sopra la linea delle nuvole, sull'altopiano fluttuante di Sol-Aethel, la Cittadella Silente si profila con terrificante maestosità. High upon the alabaster ramparts overloo: In alto, sui bastioni di alabastro che sovrastano Sol-Aethel, la compagnia accende un braciere scoppiettante di betulla bianca. I place my palm near the pulsing obsidia: Metto il palmo della mano vicino ai pulsanti obelischi di ossidiana. Un ronzio disgustoso e discordante mi vibra nel midollo. Discernere la loro frequenza controarmonica garantisce che i nostri incantesimi infrangeranno la loro barriera!

The fellowship makes rest beneath the dr: The fellowship makes rest beneath the drifting constellation of freed voices, wrapped in songs the reservoir will never drink again. Sleep comes easily, woundless and deep, and in the morning the Ribbon Stair stands bright, waiting to be climbed.

The fellowship takes its rest at the mou: The fellowship takes its rest at the mouth of the gorge as the smoke clears and the first clean wind of morning rushes through the canyon. Wounds are bound, silence is broken with campfire talk, and by light of the risen sun the path to Ouros stands open.
The fellowship rests in the antechamber: The fellowship rests in the antechamber of the belfry, tenders to each other's armor and robes under the first stars of an infinite hour. When they rise, they are whole, and the Bell of Eternity has grown impatient with silence.
The fire burns down to amber embers as t: The fire burns down to amber embers as the four companions check straps, tighten cloaks, and share a quiet moment of unity. The fellowship wades into the churning w: The fellowship wades into the churning waters of the sacred pool! The fire dwindles to a bed of glowing co: The fire dwindles to a bed of glowing coals as midnight passes. Cedric wraps himself in his heavy cloak to take first watch. Rest comes deep and undisturbed. At first light, you pack your bedrolls and gaze southwest toward the rotting canopy of Chapter 5.
The four companions pause on the final l: The four companions pause on the final landing before the great double doors. The fellowship stands at the edge of destiny.

The four companions gather under the Bel: The four companions gather under the Bell of Eternity, hands on the cord of braided starlight, and hold the incantation ready in the living hush. The four companions stand at the thresho: The four companions stand at the threshold of the belfry, looking across the final floor to the waiting Bell. One long breath passes through them all at once. This is the last step before the last word.

The four harmonic disciplines are gather: The four harmonic disciplines are gathered: Flame, Dawn, Grove, and Shadow. But before we assault Ouros, we have preparations to make.

The frozen Archons... their minds are st: The frozen Archons... their minds are still trapped in prayer. They warn us: the lake has a guardian—the Leviathan of Whispers. It feeds upon the harvested voices of the drowned!
The garrison ranks lie broken across the: The garrison ranks lie broken across the flagstones, and the lamps they guarded still burn. The gears click into place! Look — the s: The gears click into place! Look — the stone pedestal is sliding open with a golden glow!
The golden doors swing wide on their own: The golden doors swing wide on their own, silent as everything Malakor has made. Beyond them, at the far end of the belfry floor, the Bell of Eternity hangs in a field of starlight — and the pathway to it is open, waiting, absolute.
The gorge narrows ahead into the killing: The gorge narrows ahead into the killing lanes Nocturne staked out decades ago: glass-edged culverts, blackened shrines to the mute, and cauterized scaffolding where the Black Guild once trained its apprentices in silence. The husks crumble into silt, and for a s: The husks crumble into silt, and for a single beat the lake goes clear as glass. Lyra watches the drowned settle gently to the bottom and speaks the old grove-prayer over them. 'They were not taken by the water,' she says. 'They were taken by forgetting.'
The golden morning sun reflects off the: The golden morning sun reflects off the restored village roofs. The silence of this land is broken, Sir Cedric. We will not stop until every bell in Aethelgard chimes again.
The last mote of Malakor's light rises p: The last mote of Malakor's light rises past your face and is gone into the auroras. In the hush that follows, you realize the summit is not silent at all — it is humming, the four-line Primordial Incantation already forming itself unbidden in each of your four voices, waiting for one joined breath.
The jade carvings along the Veridian Chi: The jade carvings along the Veridian Chime glow softly. Inscribed in the script of the First Age are the words: 'That which was silenced in roots shall awaken in song.' The chime vibrates eagerly, attuned to the botanical frequency awaiting your tuning rite!
The ledger runs to thousands of names, e: The ledger runs to thousands of names, each struck through with a guild seal. Zephyr begins at the oldest page and reads every name aloud, unbroken, until his voice has restored each one to the air. The sealed lead jars hum in answer, refusing to be silent.
The liquid silence rises into a towering: The liquid silence rises into a towering tidal wave as the colossal Abyssal Leviathan breaches the surface! Tendrils of pure void lash out, suffocating all sound in their wake! Descend the umbilical trench into the Leviathan's den.
The leeches burst into cataracts of free: The leeches burst into cataracts of freed motes, and the voice-stars they release spiral up through the trench like a river of lantern-light. Lyra staggers under the swell of it — a thousand names and lullabies rushing past her ears, all of them, at last, free.
The morning sun climbs high above the ma: The morning sun climbs high above the mausoleum arches. The fellowship shares dried fruit and clear spring water, spirits renewed by Cedric's peace. Stepping past the colonnade, you draw weapons and advance toward Chapter 10's tangled canopy.
The outer ironworks churn in a deafening: The outer ironworks churn in a deafening heart of pistons and drop-forges. Catwalks cross roaring furnaces, and at every junction, armored clockwork sentinels stand locked mid-march, waiting for the intrusion alarm to let them finish their stride.
The path to Nocturne's sanctum lies open: The path to Nocturne's sanctum lies open and silent. In the hush, the gorge feels less like a hunting ground and more like a tomb waiting to be emptied of its ghost.
The mirrors shatter all at once — and fr: The mirrors shatter all at once — and from the shards, the Mirror Gauntlet rises: the doubt-shadows of the entire fellowship, given blade and shape, their reflections turning against their originals in Malakor's last trick before the dais!
The moment you whisper, incandescent azu: The moment you whisper, incandescent azure sparks erupt from your lips! A surge of tingling warmth races through your chest. Your voice... it has weight. It has physical power.
The penitent knights crumble, at last re: The penitent knights crumble, at last released from their vigil. Cedric bows his head to them. 'They asked for judgment and were given only silence. May the dawn be kinder to them than their order was.'
The pinnacle of the Spire of Echoes touc: The pinnacle of the Spire of Echoes touches the outer rim of the cosmos. High above hangs the Fourth Great Bell—The Bell of Eternity—cast from star-metal and meteoric glass. Grand Inquisitor Malakor stands beneath it, his filigree muzzle mask gleaming beneath cold crimson eyes.
The preparatory runes glow with incandes: The preparatory runes glow with incandescent jade light! The Veridian Chime is primed to awaken. But beneath the pool, the ancient silt core thrashes—a gargantuan Mire Wyrm rises to crush the chime before it can ring! Unleash the Logos and destroy the Mire Wyrm!
The perimeter is secured, their ambush t: The perimeter is secured, their ambush traps disarmed, and the ward frequencies mapped! Lyra is suspended above the fane pool in a cage of writhing black briars. It is time. Draw your breath, Invocator—we charge to her rescue! Sound the battle cry and breach the Briar Cage!
The reservoir shore is a drowned pilgrim: The reservoir shore is a drowned pilgrim road, its flagstones half-swallowed by the black lake. Broken lanterns line the way, and the water laps without a sound — a wrongness that presses on the ears like held breath.
The protective spores coat our armor, an: The protective spores coat our armor, and the sacred destiny of the Veridian Chime is etched in our hearts! The three of us fight as one fellowship. Invocator, give the command and let us cleanse the Weeping Willow! March into the willow roots and destroy the Bog Behemoth!
The prowlers shatter into inert ash! Fro: The prowlers shatter into inert ash! From their belt satchel, I've recovered an obsidian order cipher from the Mute Sovereign — their vanguard is fortifying the Bell Tower. Our perimeter is now secure!
The sentinels' acoustic weakness is know: The sentinels' acoustic weakness is known and the death wards are shattered! Look at the gates — the ancient sun-gears are turning! Brace yourself, Invocator, the queen descends!
The ribbon of freed motes carves a tunne: The ribbon of freed motes carves a tunnel of light back up to the reservoir floor, and you rise with it into the open air of the lakeshore — just as the black water convulses and the Abyssal Leviathan bursts from the reservoir's heart, howling with all the voices it has swallowed!
The second archway curtains the stair in: The second archway curtains the stair in tender green shadow. Within it, the companion whose heart was torn between duty and homeland steps forward — Lyra, who fled the choir, and has not forgiven herself for it.
The shadow assassins dissolve at the fir: The shadow assassins dissolve at the first stroke of a blade that no longer hunts. Zephyr stands in the returning starlight, and for the first time his own shadow at his feet looks like a guard, not a chain.
The sentinels whirl around with venomous: The sentinels whirl around with venomous mandibles, leaping from the buttress! Cedric locks his golden shield into place: 'They've caught our scent! Purge the vanguard!'
The shore of the Reservoir is quiet agai: The shore of the Reservoir is quiet again, but now it is the quiet of the living, not of the void. The drowned lights of the voice motes shift below the surface, and the true crossing opens ahead.
The shallows erupt! Drowned husks — pilg: The shallows erupt! Drowned husks — pilgrims who waded in seeking their stolen voices only to be caught by the lake — drag themselves ashore by the hundreds, their throats still open in silent screams, and close on the fellowship!
The stalkers fall, and with them the gui: The stalkers fall, and with them the guild's watch on the approach. Zephyr gathers a handful of their broken mask-class tokens and casts them into the vents. 'They were children, once. So was I. Nocturne made us all the same blade — and dulled us with it.'
The sky bridge hangs like a fallen moonb: The sky bridge hangs like a fallen moonbeam, wide enough for a full company, spanning from the belfry platform to the distant marble walls of the capital. Below, the Blight-ravaged kingdom lies folded in shadow — and for the first time, the road home is made of light.
The spring roils violently! The Blighted: The spring roils violently! The Blighted Broodmother—a colossal arachnid behemoth dripping with obsidian venom—climbs from the pit, hissing with discordant screeching! Cleanse the sacred spring and crush the Blighted Broodmother!
The streets of Sol-Aethel were once fill: The streets of Sol-Aethel were once filled with songs, market calls, and the laughter of children. Now it is a graveyard of black glass and petrified sentinels. Malakor has turned our glorious capital into a monument to grief.
The thicket gives way at last to the mar: The thicket gives way at last to the marrow of the grove: the silent spring where thirty frozen dryads stand around the blackened waters, waiting for a voice. You step onto the living shore and the wait ends.
The three archways stand open behind the: The three archways stand open behind the fellowship as the stair reaches its crown — a wide starlit landing before the great double doors of the Celestial Belfry. Ahead, the doors hum with expectation, waiting on one last, human pause.
The third archway bleeds darkness into t: The third archway bleeds darkness into the ascending light. Within it, the companion who has lived longest in shadow waits to be judged — Zephyr, the guild's blade who has carried the silence of his mother like a wound.
The threshold guardians of the Sun's Pen: The threshold guardians of the Sun's Penitence rise from the flagstones — knights who broke their vows and were buried alive at the gate itself. Wreathed in cold fire, they advance to bar the way to the Grandmaster's crypt hall!
The trench walls are lined with the calc: The trench walls are lined with the calcified shells of swallowed songs — pearl-and-glass growths that hold the dim shapes of motes thrashing inside. The way ahead splits, both branches falling into the same swallowing dark.
The vault corridor empties into a vast d: The vault corridor empties into a vast dark arena: the cavern heart of the Blind Gorge, where Master Nocturne himself waits beneath a single hanging lamp, his obsidian mask the only lit thing in the black. The chord of ending blows cold.
The tall pines outside stand completely: The tall pines outside stand completely unmoving. No wind rustle. No birdsong. The village of Whispering Pines lies under an eerie gray veil of fog.
The voices are free! They swirl ahead of: The voices are free! They swirl ahead of us, lighting the ribbon stair into the heavens. The summit is within our grasp! Ascend the Celestial Ribbon Stair to the Summit
The white birch burns down to fine grey: The white birch burns down to fine grey ash as midnight envelopes the capital. The fellowship binds water-breathing charms to their collars and checks their gear one final time. Standing at the brink of the reservoir, you prepare to dive into the watery abyss of Chapter 14.
The warden-automata grind to a halt, spa: The warden-automata grind to a halt, sparks guttering out of their cracked cores. Cedric wipes cinders from his brow. 'It will take more than iron to keep this bell from ringing,' he says, and the forge-light glints off his smile.
Their dark ward is broken! Look inside t: Their dark ward is broken! Look inside the altar vault — the Sun-Iron Bell Clapper! It radiates with the warmth of an ancient star. With this clapper, the Great Bell of Solaria will ring once more!
Their vocal cords have turned into black: Their vocal cords have turned into black glass... The Silent Blight has stolen their voices and their souls.
The whole village is silent. I have to c: The whole village is silent. I have to check on the others.
There she hangs... The Great Bell of Sol: There she hangs... The Great Bell of Solaria! But the Sovereign's royal iron vanguard has seized the belfry! An ironclad captain and his archers block the bell ropes!
They are still alive! A faint emerald he: They are still alive! A faint emerald heartbeat resonates through the stone. Their spirits are trapped in petrified amber. If we purify the Elder Spring with the Logos, they will sing again!
Then our purpose is clear. My voice and: Then our purpose is clear. My voice and your shield will reignite the chimes of Aethelgard. The Fellowship of Echoes begins today!
Then let us stand together, Sir Cedric!: Then let us stand together, Sir Cedric! My incantations will burn them, your shield will hold the line!
Then we rest for the noon hour and set o: Then we rest for the noon hour and set our course southwest. To the Rotting Marsh, to Lyra the Grove Warden, and to the Second Bell Tower!
They are saved... The First Bell has chi: They are saved... The First Bell has chimed, and the eastern province is free! Yet our quest has only begun. Look southwest across the valley: the murky, toxic fog of the Rotting Marsh. The Second Bell Tower sleeps in the swamp, where the Grove Warden Lyra fights to protect the weeping willow. Whenever you are ready, Invocator, our next chapter awaits!
This is the Mausoleum of the Sun-Chanter: This is the Mausoleum of the Sun-Chanters... Look at the central pedestal! The sacred Sun-Iron Bell Clapper was cast down here by the Mute Sovereign's disciples. A Bone Acolyte is conducting an unholy ritual over the relic!
They obeyed orders without question... a: They obeyed orders without question... and in their obedience, they turned to obsidian all the same. Blind vows do not protect righteousness; only living conscience does.

Three Great Bells restored! Look—the sky: Three Great Bells restored! Look—the sky bridge has opened! The capital gates of Sol-Aethel lie just ahead. The final trial draws near!
Through the shattered roof of the mausol: Through the shattered roof of the mausoleum, the first true dawn of the old realm pours down in a column of honeyed light. The obsidian encasing the fallen knights begins to fall away like shed scales, and beneath it, still and serene, lie the unblemished bodies of the Golden Chime.

Two Blighted Trackers burst from the dar: Two Blighted Trackers burst from the darkness, razor obsidian claws poised to strike! Defend the fellowship's camp!
Two Great Bells found... one ringing wit: Two Great Bells found... one ringing with dawn, and one awaiting our rite of tuning! Unholy defiler! In the name of the Logos: Unholy defiler! In the name of the Logos and the Dawn, release the clapper and return to the dust!
Uses rhythmic acoustic cadence to manipu: Uses rhythmic acoustic cadence to manipulate ATB tempo, restore fellowship health, and shatter enemies with harmonic waves.
Two Shadow Wisps glide from the mist, th: Two Shadow Wisps glide from the mist, their razor talons aimed at your throat! Speak your incantations to defend your life!

We are at the threshold of the Drowned F: We are at the threshold of the Drowned Fane. Muffled, discordant incantations echo from the flooded pavilion ahead. How shall we coordinate the rescue assault, Invocator?
Warmth fills my chest. The primordial em: Warmth fills my chest. The primordial embers rekindle the harmonic flow within our souls.
We cannot force the main gate while the: We cannot force the main gate while the death wards hum and the sentinels flank our approach. Which objective shall we tackle first, Invocator?
When Malakor's priests came, they dumped: When Malakor's priests came, they dumped obsidian venom into the spring. The dryads sang until their voices turned to glass. I was too afraid to sing loud enough to save them... But now, with your fellowship, I will not be quiet!
Why do you fight so fiercely for voice?: Why do you fight so fiercely for voice? Every war began with a proclamation. Every betrayal began with a whisper. Wise thinking! The luminescence exposes: Wise thinking! The luminescence exposes two obsidian stalkers attempting to circle our eastern flank! Stand your ground!
Wields blistering fire, piercing frost,: Wields blistering fire, piercing frost, and crackling storm incantations. High magical burst damage.
With a deafening bellow that shakes the: With a deafening bellow that shakes the swamp canopy, the Bog Behemoth collapses into the depths! Its black corruption dissolves into shimmering emerald foam. Across the giant willow, withered branches burst into vibrant verdant leaves, and thousands of luminous blue blossoms open in joyous symphony!
With a cataclysmic blast of steam and fl: With a cataclysmic blast of steam and flying cogs, Warmaster Ouros collapses into glowing molten scrap! The fellowship grips the massive iron chain and pulls together. The Third Great Bell—The Resonant Bastion—tolls with a thunderous, metallic roar that shakes the very foundations of the earth! Across the skies, a blinding ribbon of celestial light solidifies into a sky bridge leading directly to the capital of Sol-Aethel!
With the garrison broken and the seal un: With the garrison broken and the seal undone, the high city begins, at last, to stir. Here and there a shutter opens, a lantern wavers, a frozen fountain sighs back into motion. The citizens of Sol-Aethel emerge in twos and threes, blinking in the light of their own reclaimed streets.
With a subterranean groan, the Ancient M: With a subterranean groan, the Ancient Mire Wyrm collapses and dissolves into radiant jade moss! Lyra strikes the botanical fork with all her strength against the Veridian Chime. A deafening, glorious jade toll reverberates across fifty leagues of marsh! Massive whirlpools form as the stagnant black bogwater drains through subterranean caverns, exposing the dry stone road leading into the northern crags!
Yes! My voice commands the flame!: Yes! My voice commands the flame!
With a deafening shriek of dissolving sh: With a deafening shriek of dissolving shadow, the Abyssal Leviathan bursts into millions of incandescent voice motes! The liquid silence evaporates, revealing the crystalline Ribbon Stair ascending to the Spire Summit!
You and Sir Cedric scale the damp stone: You and Sir Cedric scale the damp stone buttresses, clinging to ancient handholds above the churning gorge. Ahead, two razor-clawed sentinels crouch over pulsating black cocoons, their jagged carapaces clicking in a discordant rhythm.
You and Sir Cedric venture into the dark: You and Sir Cedric venture into the dark tree line bordering the camp. Pitch-black obsidian claw marks scar the pine bark. Fresh tracks lead toward a shadowy outcrop.
You and Sir Cedric storm the flooded cou: You and Sir Cedric storm the flooded courtyard! Suspended above the sunken fane within a cage of writhing obsidian briars hangs Lyra the Grove Warden! A hulking Bog Ironclad, a venomous Mire Stalker, and the Void Briar Binder spin around, weapons bristling with dark sorcery!
You and Sir Cedric regroup at the base o: You and Sir Cedric regroup at the base of the massive aqueduct threshold.
You bring the altar of severed tongues c: You bring the altar of severed tongues crashing down with a blast of light. Beyond it, the true sanctum door stands revealed, and from the shadows behind the fallen shrine, the guild's archivists rise to defend their silence with blades.
You ascend a stairway made of solidified: You ascend a stairway made of solidified harmonic light suspended between the clouds and stars. The four Great Bell Towers of Aethelgard form a colossal cross of gold, jade, and iron below you. Ahead stands the Celestial Belfry.
You carry Lyra to a secluded limestone a: You carry Lyra to a secluded limestone alcove framed by ancient willow roots. You clasp his gauntlet in the manner of: You clasp his gauntlet in the manner of knights sealing vows and make the promise plain: when the bells of Sol-Aethel sing again, Sir Cedric will stand at the great bell's rope and give it his name. You follow the silk-threaded wake with a: You follow the silk-threaded wake with a torch of pure voice-light, letting its hum hold the dark at bay. Around you, the cocoons of stolen songs sway like a drowned orchard, and the trench floor slants toward a vast buried chamber.
You follow the trail through the ancient: You follow the trail through the ancient pine woods. Ahead, resting against a weathered stone sun-shrine, sits a heavily armored knight. Battered golden plate shines beneath his crimson mantle.
You channel harmonic energy into the anc: You channel harmonic energy into the ancient willow seed. It sprouts luminous tendrils of emerald light that snake toward the murky spring, craving pure living water.
You draw the ward across the shallows an: You draw the ward across the shallows and the water recoils in a ring of shivering light, as if the silence itself flinches from the touch of a living syllable. Beyond the ring, the lake's surface grows taut and watchful.
You hoist the glowing Sun-Iron Clapper i: You hoist the glowing Sun-Iron Clapper into the colossal bronze bell. Together, you and Sir Cedric take hold of the velvet-wrapped ropes. Closing your eyes, you speak the sacred Invocation of Dawn: 'From flame unyielding, from darkness spoken—let the First Bell ring and silence be broken!'
You kindle sacred embers upon the solar: You kindle sacred embers upon the solar altar. Golden light washes across the crypt, dispelling the suffocating gloom. Cedric's shield begins to glow with blinding morning luminescence!
You lend your voice to a verse of the ol: You lend your voice to a verse of the old Breviary Hymn — the one the choir sang before woven silence took them. Faint emerald shimmer runs along the dryads' glass cheeks, and from one frozen throat, a syllable answers back.
You match the rhythm of the party's foot: You match the rhythm of the party's footfalls as one. The sky bridge holds firm; the wind carries the faint sound of clover-fields and far-off sheep bells, and beneath your cuirass your heart beats to the old march of returning soldiers.
You lead the fellowship in the tolling c: You lead the fellowship in the tolling chant — the verse each Bell of Aethelgard is meant to answer, the one the four companions will strike together in the belfry beyond. Their voices braid and hold a single long note, and the doors themselves shiver with the sound of what attends them.
You kneel at his side, the flagstones co: You kneel at his side, the flagstones cold beneath you both. 'Mercy is not weakness, Sir Cedric,' you say. 'It is the one command the order never taught you to obey — and the only one that ever made you a knight worth naming.'
